rules.purpose: Determine whether agent-discovered evidence is eligible for experimental rule evaluation.
required_conditions: candidate administrative record identifier exactly equals a frozen request identifier
no conflicting administrative identifier is present
rules.notes: Address or project-name similarity alone is never sufficient. This rule does not merge records.

required_conditions: source tier is archived_primary or live_primary
source field explicitly identifies a final building inspection
inspection result explicitly equals an allowed passed value
rules.notes: Agent interpretation cannot satisfy this rule; the archived structured fields must satisfy every predicate.

required_conditions: source tier is archived_primary or live_primary
an explicit permanent certificate-of-occupancy identifier or issuance date is present
rules.notes: Narrative implication, permit closeout, and temporary occupancy do not satisfy this rule.
